title: Leftover Percent Schedule for Member Appeals to Out-of-Network Plans Paying First — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Schedule — Insurance Coverage & Claims, member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays first.** The member's leftover is the exposed charges times the first-plan member appeal's leftover percent, divided by one hundred.

| Deductible amounts assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months | Leftover percent |
|---|---|
| Reach 80.00 USD (the first-plan deductible satisfied amount) | 40 percent (first-plan coinsurance percent) |
| Above zero but below 80.00 USD | 70 percent (first-plan deductible phase percent) |
| None | 55 percent (first-plan standard leftover percent) |

### Footnotes

1. Deductible amounts are the patient-responsibility lines of the deductible type assigned on the coverage within the twelve months.
2. A twelve-month total of exactly 80.00 USD reaches the amount and takes 40 percent; 79.99 USD takes 70 percent.

### Hypothetical line

Exposed charges of 255.00 USD with 80.00 USD of deductible assigned in the twelve months: 40 percent, so the member's leftover is 255.00 times 40, divided by one hundred, 102.00 USD.
